name: Duck Duck Goose
description: A warm, inviting and unintimidating concept store celebrating South African design and culture. We curate independently owned SA fashion and lifestyle brands alongside international labels, from graphic tees to homeware.
location: 120 Bree Street, Cape Town City Centre
